title: Visual Notes Sidecar
description: Sidecar JSON written next to a daily note describing the extracted concept-map graph. Consumed by both the Obsidian plugin (renders the visual) and the Claude Code plugin (may produce it).

title.description: Visual title (window title equivalent). Auto-derived from filename + date when omitted.

header.description: Visual header shown top-left of the canvas. Usually 'Daily Overview' or 'Session N'.

subtitle.description: One-line summary of the day's themes shown under the header.

_lastProcessedHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the markdown body the sidecar was extracted from. Used to skip redundant API calls when the markdown hasn't changed (handles Obsidian Sync's per-device modify storm).

_extractedBy.description: Identifier for the producer that wrote this sidecar, e.g. 'obsidian-plugin@0.1.0' or 'claude-code-plugin@0.1.0'. Useful for debugging which producer wrote a given sidecar.

_schemaVersion.description: Schema version string (semver). Optional in v0.x; required in v1.0+.

_pinned.description: When true, suppresses automatic re-extraction by the Obsidian plugin. Future feature; useful when the user wants to keep an agent-curated sidecar from being overwritten by LLM extraction.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Slug of the concept name.

label.description: Display label. Use \n for line breaks (target ~2-4 words per line).

classes.description: Space-separated class list. Combine one type class with one status class. Type: system|task|decision. Status: completed|active|context|blocked.

position.description: Pixel coordinates (LLM-assigned in v0.x; may become optional in future when force-directed layout is supported).

label.description: Verb phrase describing the relationship. Required for design quality; not enforced at schema level for forward compatibility.

classes.description: Optional edge style class. Empty/omitted: default 2px solid. 'strong-edge': 3px darker. 'weak-edge': 1px dashed (use for cross-domain connections).
